title: Apply respects the pending deadline
summary: Every accepted Apply has a pending deadline t and a finite validity lower bound l such that t ≤ l.

title: Apply promotes the pending value and clears the proposal
summary: Every accepted Apply sets current in the selected continuation’s inline datum to the input’s pending value and sets both next and next_apply to None.

title: Settings updates preserve the input’s value
summary: In a ledger-valid transaction, every accepted Propose or Apply preserves the spent Settings input’s non-ADA assets and quantities exactly, and the selected continuation keeps at least as much lovelace.

title: Proposals respect the delay floor
summary: Every accepted Propose has a finite validity upper bound u and sets the pending deadline to at least u + apply_delay.

title: Propose preserves the active value and stages a different one
summary: Every accepted Propose preserves current in the continuation’s inline datum and writes a complete pending pair whose proposed value differs from current.

title: Settings actions require their configured credential
summary: Every accepted Propose satisfies the configured proposer credential. Every accepted launch (Mint), Apply, or Close satisfies the configured applier credential.

title: Launch establishes the initial Settings output
summary: Every accepted launch spends the configured seed and mints exactly one named Settings NFT under its policy. The selected output is locked at the Settings script, holds that NFT as its only non-ADA asset, and has an inline datum with both pending fields empty.

title: Close burns the instance NFT and ends the lifecycle
summary: A ledger-valid transaction that closes a genuine Settings output using Close and Burn burns exactly one copy of its configured NFT. The same instance cannot relaunch because launch already consumed its seed.

title: Settings updates preserve the continuation address and form
summary: Every accepted Propose or Apply has a continuation at out_ix with the spent Settings input’s full address, including its staking credential. The continuation has an inline datum and no reference script.

title: Settings updates compose with unrelated inputs and outputs
summary: Within documented execution bounds, changing unrelated inputs or outputs leaves the Settings validator’s Propose or Apply acceptance unchanged when the parameters, redeemer, spending datum, selected input and continuation, authorization result, and relevant validity bound are preserved.
